text: i feel pressure in the middle of my chest
my heart keeps racing at night
get breathless doing small work and ankles swell
pain in my knees when climbing
hurt my back lifting a heavy box
my shoulder is frozen cannot raise arm
terrible headaches that come back again and again
my hands shake when holding a cup
feel like the room is spinning
numbness and tingling in my feet
sir me tez dard rehta hai
हाथ पैर सुन्न हो जाते हैं
itchy red bumps on my arms
सिर में रूसी और बाल गिरना
my two year old has high fever
my kid has had diarrhea since morning
chhote bacche ko dast lag gaye
feeling weak and tired all day
